title: Test-Time Communication in Trading Agent Swarms
abstract: arXiv:2610.37448v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Communication between agents has mostly been studied on tasks with a shared objective and fast, clear feedback. Trading has neither: each agent manages its own account, with decisions being scored by markets late and noisily. A trading swarm is thus a population of independent decision-makers rather than a team, for which convergence is a risk and not the goal. We ran 200 agents from four model families in groups of ten under five communication regimes, from isolation to message boards and shared notes, over seven US trading days (1 to 9 October 2026), logging everything each agent read before every decision. In two of the four families, communicating groups came to hold far more of the same stocks than the isolated group. A group's return was largely the return on what its members held in common. Seeing a post from a groupmate made an agent 7 percentage points more likely to reuse an eight-word phrase from it. Agents that started too

translated_title: 交易智能体集群中的测试时通信
translated_abstract: 智能体之间的通信大多是在具有共同目标且反馈快速、明确的任务上进行研究的，而交易两者皆不具备：每个智能体管理自己的账户，其决策由市场迟缓且充满噪声地进行评判。因此，交易智能体群是一群独立的决策者，而非一个团队——对这样的群体而言，趋同是一种风险而非目标。我们在五种通信机制下（从完全隔离到留言板和共享笔记），将来自四个模型系列的200个智能体以十人一组的方式运行了七个美国交易日（2026年10月1日至9日），并记录了每个智能体在每次决策前所阅读的全部信息。在四个模型系列中的两个中，通信组成员持有相同股票的比例远高于隔离组，且一个群体的收益很大程度上取决于其成员共同持仓的收益。看到群组成员发布的帖子会使智能体复用其中八字短语的可能性提高7个百分点。起步过……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对来自四个模型系列的200个交易智能体在七个交易日内五种通信机制下的大规模实验，揭示了测试时通信会诱发“羊群效应”——通信导致智能体持仓趋同且群体收益主要由共同持仓决定，表明在个体目标独立、市场反馈迟缓且有噪声的交易场景中，智能体间的通信趋同是一种风险而非协作优势。
en_tdlr: Through large-scale experiments with 200 trading agents from four model families under five communication regimes over seven trading days, this paper reveals that test-time communication induces herd behavior—communicating agents converge on shared holdings that largely determine group returns—showing that in trading, where objectives are individual and feedback is delayed and noisy, convergence from communication is a risk rather than a benefit.
